parts.title: Rearrange — moving axes around
parts.description: Transpose, flatten, split and merge axes with rearrange. No numbers change, only the layout.

parts.title: Reduce — pooling over axes
parts.description: Mean/max/sum-pool whole axes or fixed-size patches with reduce.

parts.title: Repeat — broadcasting and tiling
parts.description: Copy data along new or existing axes with repeat.

parts.title: Einsum — contractions
parts.description: Batched matmuls, attention scores, weighted sums and traces with einsum.

parts.title: Pack & unpack — variadic axes
parts.description: Flatten and concatenate ragged-rank tensors with pack.

steps.name: transpose_2d
steps.doc: Transpose a 2-D array: swap its two axes.

steps.name: flatten_image
steps.doc: Flatten a 2-D array into a 1-D vector in row-major (C) order.

steps.name: merge_batch_and_time
steps.doc: Collapse the leading (batch, time) axes of a 3-D array into one, giving (batch*time, features).

steps.name: split_into_heads
steps.doc: Reshape (batch, seq, dim) into (batch, heads, seq, head_dim) by splitting the last axis into `heads` equal groups.

steps.name: channels_last_to_first
steps.doc: Convert an image batch from NHWC to NCHW layout (move the channel axis from last to second).

steps.name: global_average_pool
steps.doc: Average each channel of an NCHW image batch over its spatial dims, giving (N, C).

steps.name: max_pool_2x2
steps.doc: 2x2 max-pool an NCHW image batch (H and W are even), halving each spatial dim.

steps.name: sequence_mean
steps.doc: Mean-pool a (batch, seq, dim) array over the sequence axis, giving (batch, dim).

steps.name: gray_to_rgb
steps.doc: Turn a 2-D grayscale image (H, W) into an (H, W, 3) RGB image by copying it across 3 channels.

steps.name: tile_rows
steps.doc: Stack `n` identical copies of a 1-D vector into an (n, len) array.

steps.name: upsample_nearest
steps.doc: Nearest-neighbour upsample a 2-D array by an integer `factor` along both axes.

steps.name: batched_matmul
steps.doc: Batched matrix multiply: (B, I, K) times (B, K, J) gives (B, I, J).

steps.name: attention_scores
steps.doc: Dot-product attention scores: queries (B, Q, D) and keys (B, K, D) give (B, Q, K).

steps.name: weighted_token_sum
steps.doc: Weighted sum of value vectors: weights (B, Q, K) and values (B, K, D) give (B, Q, D).

steps.name: trace_batch
steps.doc: Trace (sum of the diagonal) of each matrix in a batch (B, N, N), giving (B,).

steps.name: flatten_keep_batch
steps.doc: Flatten every axis except the first into one, giving (B, M) from a batch of any rank >= 1.

steps.name: concat_features
steps.doc: Concatenate two feature maps (H, W, C1) and (H, W, C2) along the channel axis, giving (H, W, C1+C2).
